notes: Merged 'Shower enclosure' and 'Bath or shower screen' into one kind with quadrant/walk-in/bath-screen types (screen kind dissolved, not dropped). Heated towel rail gets archetypes for Zehnder, VOLA, Bisque plus maker-free ladder and swivel forms; Vogue UK designs placed as ladder versions. Left out: Zehnder Charleston as a towel-rail archetype (source lists it as a living-room column radiator; belongs with radiators) and Bisque Hot Spring (a radiator, kept only in the brand register); Bisque Classic not confirmed as a towel rail by any retrieved page; VOLA T39 launch year not found (only a 2009 award). No enclosure/panel brands added because no market or test source was retrieved; old models kept. No traditions apply.
